keyFeaturesAndFixes: Live Brawl matchmaking now fills five total seats through sequential 650ms real-player search windows.
Committed bot seats are permanent and cannot be replaced by late real-player joins.
Server-side room advancement adds at most one bot per expired search window and starts the match only at five total seats.
Round timer stays visible as a floating sticky timer while players scroll through the answer screen.
Client and Supabase matchmaking targets are aligned at five total seats.
Solo human Live Brawl rounds against bot-filled seats now receive server-authored answer verdicts and points instead of finishing at zero.
Unknown answers are reviewable instead of treated as invalid, with server-side validation cache support for category-aware enrichment.
Reviewable answers now enqueue background enrichment jobs with deduplication, retry state, monitoring events, and a Supabase Edge Function worker path.
The in-app Check meaning action now uses the server-authoritative validation path instead of calling a dictionary API directly from the phone.
